title: The President / Executive Directors / Managing Directors of all the Stock Exchanges - CBTD notification
text: Home »Legal»Circulars The President / Executive Directors / Managing Directors of all the Stock Exchanges - CBTD notification Dec 03, 1998| Circulars SECURITIES AND EXCHANGE BOARD OF INDIASECONDARY MARKET DEPARTMENTMittal Court, A Wing, Gr. Floor,224, Nariman Point, Mumbai 400 021 SMDRP/POLICY/CIR-36 /98December 03, 1998 To: The President/Executive Directors/Managing Directorsof All the Stock Exchanges. Dear Sir, Central Board of Direct Taxes vide its notification dated October 09, 1998 (copy enclosed) has made it mandatory for every person to quote his/her PAN/GIR in all documents pertaining to any contract of a value exceeding ten lakh rupees for sale or purchase of securities as defined in Clause (h) of Section 2 of the SCRA. You are advised to keep your members informed about the above, for needful compliance. Yours faithfully, P.K.BINDLISHDivision ChiefSecondary Market,DepositoryResearch & Publications DepartmentE-mail:pkb@sebi.gov.in
